info.title: Urban Ticketing Hub demo API
info.description: Integer NAD minor units, UUID application IDs, UTC timestamps, strict request fields. All success responses currently use HTTP 200. Retry checkout, booking, payment and refund with the same requestKey and semantic input. Payments are simulated.
